isolation_follow_up.method: Spawned writer calls real LedgerStore.commit_stage. A sqlite3.Connection subclass pauses immediately before real commit, or raises a controlled error so existing immediate_transaction rolls back. Reader calls production build_current_state with a real-connection trace callback only for Pipe synchronization. No sleep ordering. All database files are temporary synthetic fixtures.
outcomes: Uncommitted reader equals complete prior projection.
Commit exposes new artifact/stage/counts to a subsequent reader; rollback and writer SIGKILL preserve prior projection.
Commit before first snapshot read returns new version.
Commit mid-watermark, after watermark or before artifact aggregation returns complete old version for the in-flight reader, new version for a fresh reader.
Whole projection equality includes ledger counts and version identity; source_generation digest is recomputed. Artifact ID and SHA256 are checked against fixture payload.
Explicit test-only removal of BEGIN produces mixed version (watermark artifacts=0, summary artifacts=1); negative control detects it. Production transaction unchanged.
